user.description: Enter the local IP address of your APsystems EZHI inverter. The cloud fields are optional and only needed for the remote control entities (on/off, system mode, SOC limits) — see the README on how to obtain the tokens.
user.title: APsystems EZHI

reauth_confirm.description: The stored cloud refresh token is no longer valid. Capture a new pair from the AP EasyPower app and enter it here.
reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect APsystems cloud

error.connection_refused: Unable to connect to the inverter. Check the IP address.
error.cloud_auth_failed: The cloud rejected these credentials. Check that you copied both tokens correctly.

device_options.description: Polling intervals for the local API, and the optional cloud credentials. Enter your APsystems EMA username and password to fetch the tokens automatically — the username, not the e-mail address. They are used once and never stored.
device_options.title: APsystems EZHI options

error.invalid_auth: The EMA cloud rejected that username and password. Note that it wants the account username, not the e-mail address.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the EMA cloud. Try again in a moment.
error.incomplete_credentials: Enter both the username and the password, or neither.

options.bluetooth: Bluetooth (wakes the device over the cloud when needed)
options.local_mqtt: Local MQTT broker (needs the device pointed at it; a bridging broker keeps the vendor app working -- see the docs)
